examples: The tourists had to mount their horses before sunrise to reach the summit by noon.
گردشگران باید قبل از طلوع آفتاب سوار اسب‌هایشان می‌شدند تا تا ظهر به قله برسند.
Workers will mount the new security cameras above every entrance next week.
کارگران هفته آینده دوربین‌های امنیتی جدید را بالای هر ورودی نصب خواهند کرد.
Pressure continued to mount on the company after the second product recall.
بعد از دومین فراخوان محصول، فشار بر شرکت همچنان رو به افزایش بود.
miniContext: To mount something can mean to climb onto it, to attach it in place, or to gradually increase. A rider must learn to mount a horse smoothly to avoid startling the animal. Electricians mount light fixtures carefully so they stay secure for years. As ticket sales slowed, pressure continued to mount on the organizers to lower prices.

examples: Hundreds of runners will compete in the marathon this weekend.
صدها دونده این آخر هفته در ماراتن شرکت خواهند کرد و با هم رقابت خواهند کرد.
Small bookstores struggle to compete with large online retailers on price.
کتاب‌فروشی‌های کوچک برای رقابت با فروشگاه‌های آنلاین بزرگ بر سر قیمت دچار مشکل هستند.
She trained for years to compete at the national level in swimming.
او سال‌ها تمرین کرد تا بتواند در سطح ملی شنا رقابت کند.
miniContext: To compete means to try to win against others in a contest, sport, or market. Athletes train for years just to compete at the Olympic level for a few minutes. Small farms often compete with large agricultural companies by focusing on quality over quantity. Siblings sometimes compete for their parents' attention without even realizing it.

examples: I always dread the first day back at school after summer vacation.
من همیشه از اولین روز بازگشت به مدرسه بعد از تعطیلات تابستانی هراس دارم.
Many patients dread visiting the dentist, even for a routine checkup.
بسیاری از بیماران حتی برای یک معاینه معمولی از رفتن به دندان‌پزشک هراس دارند.
She felt a growing sense of dread as the storm clouds rolled closer.
با نزدیک شدن ابرهای طوفانی، او احساس هراس فزاینده‌ای در خود حس کرد.
miniContext: Dread is a heavy feeling of fear about something that hasn't happened yet. Many people dread public speaking far more than they fear physical danger. Children often dread the first day of a new school, even when they end up loving it. The growing dread before a big exam can sometimes be worse than the exam itself.

examples: He has a deep, masculine voice that fills the entire room when he speaks.
او صدایی عمیق و مردانه دارد که وقتی صحبت می‌کند تمام اتاق را پر می‌کند.
The advertisement used masculine imagery, like rugged mountains and heavy machinery, to sell the truck.
تبلیغ برای فروش کامیون از تصاویر مردانه‌ای مانند کوه‌های خشن و ماشین‌آلات سنگین استفاده کرد.
Many cultures have different ideas about what counts as masculine behavior.
فرهنگ‌های مختلف درباره اینکه چه رفتاری مردانه محسوب می‌شود، ایده‌های متفاوتی دارند.
miniContext: Masculine traits are those traditionally associated with men, such as physical strength or a deep voice, though ideas about this vary across cultures. A masculine design for a car might emphasize bold lines and powerful engines. Some actors are praised for playing masculine roles with surprising emotional depth. What counts as masculine has shifted considerably over the past few decades.

examples: Rising sea levels pose a growing menace to coastal communities.
افزایش سطح دریا تهدیدی رو به رشد برای جوامع ساحلی به‌شمار می‌رود.
The escaped bull was seen as a menace to anyone walking near the farm.
گاو فراری به‌عنوان تهدیدی برای هر کسی که نزدیک مزرعه راه می‌رفت، در نظر گرفته می‌شد.
Local officials warned that the unchecked wildfire could menace nearby villages within hours.
مقامات محلی هشدار دادند که آتش‌سوزی کنترل‌نشده می‌تواند ظرف چند ساعت روستاهای نزدیک را تهدید کند.
miniContext: A menace is a serious threat or danger, often something that lurks just out of sight. Unchecked wildfires can become a menace to entire towns within hours. A loose dog running through traffic was seen as a menace to drivers and pedestrians alike. Online scams are a growing menace that costs victims billions of dollars every year.

examples: He has a tendency to arrive late to almost every meeting.
او تمایل دارد که تقریباً به هر جلسه‌ای با تأخیر برسد.
There is a growing tendency among young people to work from home.
گرایشی رو به رشد در میان جوانان برای کار کردن از خانه وجود دارد.
Her tendency to double-check everything makes her a reliable editor.
گرایش او به بررسی دوباره همه چیز، او را به ویراستاری قابل‌اعتماد تبدیل می‌کند.
miniContext: A tendency is a habit or natural inclination to behave in a certain way. He has a tendency to forget names right after being introduced. Markets show a tendency to rise during the holiday shopping season. Recognizing your own tendency toward procrastination is the first step to overcoming it.

examples: Never underestimate how much preparation a marathon actually requires.
هرگز دست‌کم نگیر که دویدن ماراتن چقدر آمادگی واقعی نیاز دارد.
Investors tend to underestimate the risks of a market that has only gone up.
سرمایه‌گذاران معمولاً ریسک‌های بازاری را که فقط رشد کرده، دست‌کم می‌گیرند.
The coach underestimated the opposing team and lost the championship game.
مربی تیم حریف را دست‌کم گرفت و بازی قهرمانی را از دست داد.
miniContext: To underestimate something means to judge it as smaller, weaker, or less important than it really is. Never underestimate how exhausting a long flight can be, even when you're just sitting the whole time. New business owners often underestimate how much time marketing actually takes. The champion was nearly defeated because he underestimated a much younger opponent.

examples: Students who excel in mathematics often enjoy solving logic puzzles too.
دانش‌آموزانی که در ریاضیات برتری دارند، معمولاً از حل کردن پازل‌های منطقی هم لذت می‌برند.
She hopes to excel at her new job by learning the systems quickly.
او امید دارد با یادگیری سریع سیستم‌ها در شغل جدیدش برتری پیدا کند.
The young gymnast continues to excel in every competition she enters.
آن ژیمناست جوان در هر مسابقه‌ای که شرکت می‌کند همچنان برتری دارد.
miniContext: To excel means to perform extremely well, often better than most other people in the same activity. Some students excel in creative subjects like art and music rather than traditional exams. A good coach helps every player excel in whatever position suits them best. She continued to excel at her job even after switching to a completely new industry.

examples: Without regular exercise, muscles can quickly become flabby and weak.
بدون ورزش منظم، عضلات می‌توانند به‌سرعت شل و بی‌قوام و ضعیف شوند.
The trainer promised to turn his flabby arms into toned muscle within months.
مربی قول داد بازوهای شل او را در عرض چند ماه به عضله‌ای ورزیده تبدیل کند.
Critics called the new policy flabby, saying it lacked any real enforcement.
منتقدان سیاست جدید را سست و بی‌قوام خواندند و گفتند فاقد هرگونه اجرای واقعی است.
miniContext: Flabby describes something soft and lacking firmness, whether it's a muscle or an argument. Without any exercise, his once-strong arms gradually became flabby. Reviewers called the new regulation flabby, meaning it sounded strict but had almost no real enforcement behind it. A flabby excuse rarely convinces a parent or a boss.

examples: Numerous studies have shown a clear link between sleep and memory.
مطالعات متعددی ارتباط واضحی بین خواب و حافظه را نشان داده‌اند.
The city has numerous parks where families can spend a sunny afternoon.
این شهر پارک‌های متعددی دارد که خانواده‌ها می‌توانند یک بعدازظهر آفتابی را در آن بگذرانند.
She received numerous complaints about the noise coming from the construction site.
او شکایت‌های متعددی درباره سر و صدای کارگاه ساخت‌وساز دریافت کرد.
miniContext: Numerous simply means very many, used when a precise number isn't necessary. Numerous witnesses came forward after the accident to describe what they had seen. The city has made numerous improvements to its public transportation system over the past decade. Despite numerous attempts, the team couldn't fix the software bug before launch.

examples: The dress had a soft, feminine style with delicate lace along the sleeves.
آن لباس سبکی ملایم و زنانه داشت با تور ظریف در آستین‌ها.
Pink and lavender are often associated with feminine fashion, though that's changing.
رنگ‌های صورتی و بنفش معمولاً با مد زنانه مرتبط هستند، هرچند این دیدگاه در حال تغییر است.
She admired the feminine energy in the painting, calm yet quietly powerful.
او از انرژی زنانه موجود در نقاشی تحسین کرد، آرام اما به‌شکلی ساکت قدرتمند.
miniContext: Feminine traits are those traditionally linked to women, such as gentleness or grace, though definitions of this continue to evolve. Designers sometimes use soft curves and pastel colors to create a feminine aesthetic. The actress was praised for bringing both feminine warmth and steely determination to her role. Attitudes about what is considered feminine differ widely from one culture to another.

examples: The home team emerged victorious after a dramatic overtime goal.
تیم میزبان بعد از یک گل دراماتیک در وقت اضافه پیروز میدان شد.
After months of campaigning, the young candidate was finally victorious in the election.
بعد از ماه‌ها فعالیت انتخاباتی، نامزد جوان در نهایت در انتخابات پیروز شد.
The victorious army marched back into the capital to cheering crowds.
سپاه پیروز با استقبال جمعیت شادمان به پایتخت بازگشت.
miniContext: Victorious describes someone or something that has won, especially after a hard-fought struggle. The victorious team celebrated late into the night after winning the championship. After a long legal battle, the small company emerged victorious against its much larger rival. History books tend to remember the victorious side far more vividly than the one that lost.
